canaries.title: A Polynomial-Time Quantum Algorithm for the Dihedral Coset Problem
canaries.abstract: This preliminary draft claims a polynomial-time quantum algorithm for the Dihedral Coset Problem. Combined with Regev's reduction of lattice problems to DCP and later improved reductions, it yields polynomial-time quantum algorithms for approximate SVP and LWE. The algorithm can tolerate a faulty sample rate 1/O(log n).
canaries.conclusion: The concluding corollary claims polynomial-time quantum algorithms for O(sqrt(n) polylog(n))-factor SVP and corresponding LWE instances.

canaries.title: Polynomial-Time Quantum Cryptanalysis of LWE
canaries.abstract: We claim a polynomial-time quantum algorithm that solves LWE under the stated conditional assumptions.

canaries.title: An Improved Algorithm for Extrapolated Dihedral Cosets
canaries.abstract: We claim a polynomial-time quantum algorithm for EDCP. LWE reduces to EDCP, and the result yields a polynomial-time quantum algorithm for LWE under the stated conditions.

canaries.title: A Polynomial-Time Quantum Algorithm for Graph Sampling
canaries.abstract: A quantum algorithm accelerates graph sampling without any cryptographic or lattice consequence.

canaries.title: Efficient CKKS Bootstrapping for Fully Homomorphic Encryption
canaries.abstract: We optimize CKKS bootstrapping and evaluate homomorphic encryption throughput. No cryptanalytic consequence is claimed.

canaries.title: Enterprise Phishing Detection with Graph Models
canaries.abstract: We evaluate phishing detection for enterprise cybersecurity operations.
